originalText: Huge sheets that scroll smoothly · draw only what is visible, formulas off the main thread

text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- Sparse model: store only filled cells
- Virtualize rows AND columns; canvas
  draws the visible window
- Recalc only dirty cells (dependency
  graph) in a Web Worker
- Every edit is a command: undo, redo,
  and the op sent to collaborators
- Hidden DOM grid for screen readers
